security_audit.summary: All 93 static matches are false positives: Markdown formatting, relevant documentation links, placeholder asset URLs, ordinary credential-storage documentation, and model-selection advice. One semantic concern remains: the shell-safety assurance overlooks quoting when inserting user content into single-quoted command examples. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection targeting the auditor.

remediation.issue: The shell-safety assurance ignores the shell that parses the single-quoted JSON examples before the CLI receives input.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the blanket assurance and document structured argument passing or robust shell escaping, including apostrophes in user prompts and asset URLs.

semantic_findings.title: Shell-Safety Assurance Omits Outer-Shell Quoting
semantic_findings.description: The statement "No shell-injection surface" overlooks single-quoted JSON examples. Directly inserting user text containing apostrophes can break shell quoting before the CLI receives it. JSON validity alone does not prevent shell interpretation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The assurance and single-quoted examples are explicit, but no escaping guidance addresses user substitutions. Exploitation depends on unsafe command construction; the static examples are inert.

content.user_title: Create Avatar and Lip-Sync Videos with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Choosing an avatar model depends on available images, audio, and scene requirements. This skill guides model selection and RunComfy CLI inputs for five video-generation routes.
actual_capabilities: Select among five documented routes based on recorded audio, script availability, subject style, and scene complexity.
Prepare OmniHuman inputs pairing a portrait image with a recorded voiceover.
Prepare Wan 2-7 scene prompts with an audio track, or Wan 2-2 Animate inputs for stylized characters.
Write HappyHorse text-to-video and image-to-video prompts with quoted dialogue and separate audio-tone descriptions.
Prepare Seedance cinematic prompts with reference images, reference audio, duration, and aspect ratio.
Document RunComfy installation, authentication, output-directory selection, and common CLI exit codes.
limitations: Requires a separately installed RunComfy CLI, authentication, network access, and access to the selected hosted model.
Provides instructions and examples, not a bundled video engine or independently verified CLI security controls.
Asset-based routes require reachable image or audio URLs; supplied examples contain placeholders.
Generated speech, lip synchronization, and identity consistency depend on the model; current schemas and service charges require confirmation.

use_cases.title: Localized Presenter Clips
use_cases.description: Prepare OmniHuman jobs using one authorized presenter portrait and separate voiceovers for each language.

use_cases.title: Script-Based Training Videos
use_cases.description: Prepare short HappyHorse presenter clips from written dialogue when recorded audio is unavailable.

use_cases.title: Animated Character Dialogue
use_cases.description: Prepare Wan 2-2 Animate inputs pairing an illustrated character with an authorized voice recording.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Avatar Model
prompt_templates.prompt: I have an authorized portrait and recorded voiceover for a presenter clip. Recommend the simplest documented route and list the required inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Talking Portrait
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [portrait URL] and [voiceover URL] for an OmniHuman presenter clip. Prepare the RunComfy invocation with safe argument handling. Do not submit it yet.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Script-Based Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a six-second vertical HappyHorse clip saying [short script] with a friendly tone. Show the prompt and generation settings before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Cinematic Monologue
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a ten-second Seedance monologue using [subject URL] and [audio URL]. Include lens, lighting, and aspect ratio. Verify input fields and await submission approval.

output_examples.input: I have a consented presenter portrait and a clean voiceover. Which route should I use?
output_examples.output: Recommended route: OmniHuman. Required inputs: a reachable portrait URL and voiceover URL. No scene prompt is required for the documented example.

output_examples.input: Prepare a short presenter clip from a script without a recorded voiceover.
output: Prompt: A presenter faces the camera and says clearly: "Welcome to the product demo." Audio: friendly tone, neutral accent.
Suggested settings: six seconds, vertical 9:16 framing, and 1080p resolution, subject to the current model schema.

output_examples.input: How should I prepare an illustrated mascot to speak my recorded lines?
output_examples.output: Recommended route: Wan 2-2 Animate. Supply the authorized character image and voiceover URLs. This route targets stylized characters rather than photorealistic presenters.

best_practices: Obtain permission for every likeness and voice, and disclose synthetic media where appropriate.
Use clean voice recordings and well-framed portraits; confirm the current input schema before submitting a generation.
Pass inputs through structured arguments or robust shell escaping, protect credentials, and review external processing and costs before submission.
anti_patterns: Using a real person's likeness or voice without permission, or creating harmful synthetic media.
Choosing HappyHorse when exact synchronization to an existing recording is required.
Pasting unescaped prompts into shell commands or assuming JSON encoding alone prevents command injection.

faq.question: Does this skill generate videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It guides RunComfy CLI calls to hosted models and describes downloading results to a local output directory.

faq.question: Which route fits a portrait and existing voiceover?
faq.answer: The skill recommends OmniHuman for the simplest portrait-and-audio workflow.

faq.question: Can I start with only a written script?
faq.answer: Yes. The HappyHorse examples place short quoted dialogue inside the prompt and generate audio with the video.

faq.question: Which models support stylized or cinematic subjects?
faq.answer: Wan 2-2 Animate targets illustrated characters. Seedance v2 Pro supports cinematic composition with reference assets.

faq.question: What must I install and configure?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with RunComfy. Confirm current model access and any charges before submitting jobs.

faq.question: What privacy and security checks are necessary?
faq.answer: Confirm rights to the likeness and voice, approve external asset processing, protect the API token, and handle shell arguments safely.
